name: Erfoud
hero_subtitle: Morocco’s fossil capital on the edge of the Tafilalet — palm groves, desert-town markets and a calm base for Merzouga and Erg Chebbi.

overview.title: Welcome to Erfoud — fossils, palms and the Tafilalet edge
overview.p1: Erfoud is the main town of the northern Tafilalet, long known for marine fossils cut from local stone. Workshops and museums in and around town display ammonites and trilobites from an ancient seabed.
overview.p2: The town itself is low-key: date markets, palm landscapes along the Ziz, and hotels used as a quieter alternative to staying only in Merzouga. Erg Chebbi, Rissani and Merzouga are separate destinations nearby — ideal day trips, not neighbourhoods of Erfoud.

q1.question: How many days in Erfoud?
q1.answer: One night is enough for town and workshops; add a night if you use it as a base before Merzouga.

q2.question: Is Erg Chebbi in Erfoud?
q2.answer: No. Erg Chebbi sits near Merzouga, about one hour south of Erfoud — a classic day trip from here.

q3.question: Erfoud vs Merzouga?
q3.answer: Erfoud is the larger fossil town and a quieter base. Merzouga sits at the foot of the dunes.

q4.question: Best time to visit?
q4.answer: October to April for milder temperatures.
